text:
Where does this state live?

Server data ......... query cache
Shared UI ........... global store
One component ....... local state
Filters, tabs ....... URL
Form inputs ......... form library
Survives reload ..... IndexedDB /
                      localStorage
Tokens .............. HttpOnly cookie
                      (never in JS)
